articles.summary: Against a backdrop of climate volatility, currency pressure, and shifting global markets, we made a deliberate choice to shift the focus from just growth at scale to sustainable growth, building food systems resilient enough to withstand shocks and durable enough to compound prosperity season after season.
articles.title: Beyond Scale: Building Resilient Food Systems Across Africa

articles.summary: Across Africa, and particularly in Nigeria, climate-smart agriculture is emerging as the true engine of growth.
